payload.title: Barnette finite interfaces and carrier source-input archive
payload.body:
# Barnette finite interfaces and carrier source-input archive

44 exact original files, including 27 code sources. This artifact-check REVIEW preserves source/input provenance and records the precise reproduction boundaries around the existing indexed RESULT. It is inconclusive about mathematical validity; no research code was executed.

Embedded producer fixtures, self-contained fixed carrier/parity/countermodel checkers and the 14-module one-cycle/frozen-corpus source tree are preserved. The five corpus JSON files retain 50 recorded graph6 entries; this is not the entire order-through-26 space. Dormant fresh-census branches additionally require geng/genbg and source certificates. Round6/7 had no fresh checker; hand/analytic arguments are not computationally certified. Asserts and printed VERIFIED are static/expected behavior, not fresh observations.

Raw code, fixtures, checksum-bound specifications, JSON prefixes/tails and expected records are preserved without banners or reformatting. Scientific and licence declarations live in sidecars. A file named certificate, a stored PASS or a published algorithm is not new independent proof acceptance.

Li Hongmin is the authorized human contributor; original drafting/checking was AI-assisted, with source-model identity not independently reconstructed. Codex performed static archival review and packaging. Own code Apache-2.0; original text/data CC BY 4.0; cited third-party passages retain source rights.
